title: Equivalent (Any of the Eight)
summary: Click re-lays the same invariant 120 bricks into a different one of Carl Andre's eight rectangles — all equivalent, none worth more.
mechanism: Per-click client-side DOM re-render that varies only the rectangular footprint while the brick count stays hard-coded and constant; no storage, no network.
references: Tate acquisition / the 'pile of bricks' press scandal (1972/1976)
